title: Setup: build Spring Framework spring-context at both #23893 revisions and run DateFormattingTests
description: Setup for Brief A4, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-java-data/src, builds spring-context at 4beb25b3 (landed) and 43a86565 (parent), Spring 5.2.1.BUILD-SNAPSHOT, with Gradle 5.6.3 on JDK 8 (Temurin 1.8.0_512). Runs each side's DateFormattingTests, then the landed file transplanted onto the parent, where testBindDateAnnotatedPatternWithGlobalFormat is expected to fail. The build reads repo.spring.io/libs-spring-framework-build (anonymous, 200 on 2026-11-22) and lists repo.spring.io/plugins-release after the plugin portal (401 anonymously): a plugin found only there would stop the build, which is itself a setup finding. Jars to .../artifacts with sha256, classpath to .../logs, landed tests rerun --offline, build trees removed. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/spring-and-java-data-setup.md.
expected: every step exits 0: both sides' own DateFormattingTests pass; the transplanted landed test fails on the parent with testBindDateAnnotatedPatternWithGlobalFormat; offline rerun BUILD SUCCESSFUL

resources.notes: Gradle -Xmx1536M on JDK 8 plus Kotlin 1.3 compile of spring-core/spring-context and the test JVM; first run downloads dependencies

steps.name: spring-framework-23893-landed: build spring-context, run DateFormattingTests
spring-framework-23893-parent: build spring-context, run its own DateFormattingTests
spring-framework-23893-parent: the landed DateFormattingTests transplanted (failure expected)
spring-framework-23893-landed: DateFormattingTests offline
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; B=$HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-java-data; export GRADLE_USER_HOME=$B/gradle-home TMPDIR=$B/tmp; mkdir -p $B/tmp $B/logs $B/artifacts; export JAVA_HOME=$HOME/.sdkman/candidates/java/8.0.512.0+9-tem; G="./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain -Porg.gradle.java.installations.auto-download=false "; cd $B/src/spring-framework-23893-landed; $G --offline :spring-context:cleanTest :spring-context:test --tests 'org.springframework.format.datetime.DateFormattingTests' 2>&1 | tee $B/logs/spring-framework-23893-landed.spring-context.offline-test.log | tail -5; grep -q 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL' $B/logs/spring-framework-23893-landed.spring-context.offline-test.log

steps.name: remove the build trees
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; B=$HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-java-data; export GRADLE_USER_HOME=$B/gradle-home TMPDIR=$B/tmp; mkdir -p $B/tmp $B/logs $B/artifacts; git -C $B/src/spring-framework-23893-parent clean -fdxq; git -C $B/src/spring-framework-23893-parent status --short | wc -l; git -C $B/src/spring-framework-23893-landed clean -fdxq; git -C $B/src/spring-framework-23893-landed status --short | wc -l; du -sh $B/src
